title: i18n analysis
noData: Run the scan to list hard-coded text and missing translations.

errors.noProject: Select a project before running a scan.

description: Finds hard-coded interface text on every stack and proposes a key in the project's own style, compares each locale with the reference whatever the catalog format (JSON, RESX, ARB, XLIFF, Android strings.xml, iOS .strings, gettext, .properties, Rails YAML, Laravel), and reports orphan keys, copies, placeholders, plural forms per language and right-to-left layout. Missing keys can be translated by the active model on a review card.

completeness.title: Translated, locale by locale
completeness.description: Keys translated out of the keys each locale needs. A sentence copied from the reference unchanged does not count; plural forms a language does not use are left out.

translate.action_one: Translate {{count}} missing key on a review card
translate.action_other: Translate {{count}} missing keys on a review card
translate.note: The active text model translates them; a translation that loses a placeholder or a tag is dropped. Nothing is written into the project folder: the keys go to a review card with its own branch.
translate.serverOnly: A server project's catalogs are not on this computer: translate them from a local clone.
translate.done_one: {{count}} translation added on the review card (branch {{branch}}). Review the diff, then open the pull request from the card.
translate.done_other: {{count}} translations added on the review card (branch {{branch}}). Review the diff, then open the pull request from the card.
translate.nothing: No translation was kept: nothing was written and the card was removed.
translate.noModel: No text model answered: check the provider in Settings. Nothing was written.
translate.rejected_one: {{count}} answer was dropped (placeholder, tag or no answer).
translate.rejected_other: {{count}} answers were dropped (placeholder, tag or no answer).
translate.skipped_one: {{count}} key is left for a next run.
translate.skipped_other: {{count}} keys are left for a next run.
translate.notWritable_one: {{count}} catalog is in a format WorkPilot does not write (YAML, XLIFF, gettext, PHP): {{files}}.
translate.notWritable_other: {{count}} catalogs are in a format WorkPilot does not write (YAML, XLIFF, gettext, PHP): {{files}}.

messages.unused_key: {{key}} is in {{locale}} but not in the reference locale
messages.inconsistent_params: The placeholders of {{key}} differ from the reference: {{text}}
messages.missing_plural_many: {{locale}} has no _many form: recent i18next and ICU use it for large round numbers
messages.orphan_key_possibly: No source file names {{key}}, but some keys are built at run time: check before deleting it
messages.locale_file_mismatch: {{key}}: the catalogs of {{locale}} do not match the reference

suggestions.add: Add {{key}} to the catalog, then replace the text with the call below
suggestions.reuse: The catalog already has this text: use {{key}}
suggestions.missing_key: Translate it, or use the translation button above
suggestions.unused_key: Remove it, or add it to the reference locale
suggestions.missing_plural_many: Add _many next to _other where a count can reach a million
suggestions.orphan_key: Remove it from every locale, or use it
suggestions.locale_file_mismatch: Align the catalog with the reference
